purpose: Identify source-text transformation signals already present in the current 5,389-row Item catalogs so later taxonomy/provenance adoption does not silently upgrade inferred, completed, or expanded-design content into stronger source authority.
interpretation: Counts overlap; a row may carry more than one signal.
These are review signals, not automatic defects and not authority downgrades by themselves.
A source row saying that a value was inferred, completed by best judgment, expanded by design, or completed from a malformed/partial source must preserve that transformation history during migration.
Current mechanics remain protected by the v0.12.0 preparation contract; this audit does not rewrite or invalidate them.

The future normalized provenance model should distinguish source-backed fact, current authored/expanded content, inference/completion, unresolved conflict, and later governed revision instead of flattening all Origin text into one authority class.

weapons_ammo_source_note_gap.important_boundary: Recovered provenance is stored as derived crosswalk evidence; the original Weapons_Ammo.csv source bytes are unchanged.

private_review_queue.reason: Detailed source-row names and Origin/Source Notes remain owner-held working evidence; the public AIOC repository records aggregate review evidence only.

required_use_in_projection: Carry source-row fingerprint and original provenance text reference into the shadow projection.
Do not translate textual words such as inferred or best judgment into invented numeric confidence scores.
Do not promote expanded-design rows into legacy-source fact merely because they coexist with source-derived rows.
Do not discard current mechanics; authority/provenance state and current mechanics authority are separate concerns.
Require explicit review when later product identity, compatibility or creator/origin assertions depend on transformed source fields.
